tools.name: recurpay_get_access_scopes
tools.description: Show the API scopes of the custom app whose token is connected (read-/write- subscriptions, customers, orders, plans, payments, webhooks). Use it when a tool answers 403.

tools.name: recurpay_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the store's subscriptions (status active/paused/halted/cancelled/draft, subscriber, plan policies, line items, next_billing_at). Filter by status, plan, subscriber email and dates. Use status=halted to find subscriptions whose renewal payment failed. Page with next_page.

tools.name: recurpay_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription with its subscriber, addresses, line items, discount codes, billing/delivery policy, payment method and billing dates.

tools.name: recurpay_list_subscribers
tools.description: List the store's subscribers (customers with at least one subscription): name, email, phone, addresses, total spent. Filter by name, email and dates. Page with next_page.

tools.name: recurpay_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber (customer) with contact data, addresses and total spent.

tools.name: recurpay_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders generated by subscriptions (name, subscriber, status, totals). Filter by order name, subscriber email, subscription and dates. Page with next_page.

tools.name: recurpay_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its subscriber and line items.

tools.name: recurpay_list_order_subscriptions
tools.description: List the subscriptions that belong to one order.

tools.name: recurpay_list_plans
tools.description: List the subscription plans (selling plan groups) with their delivery/billing policies and discounts. Filter by plan title, product title/handle and dates. Page with next_page.

tools.name: recurpay_get_plan
tools.description: Get one plan with its selling plans (delivery policy, billing policy, anchors, discounts).

tools.name: recurpay_list_plan_products
tools.description: List the products attached to one plan, with the variants excluded from it.

tools.name: recurpay_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the store (topic, address, status). Needs the read-webhooks scope.

tools.name: recurpay_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel one subscriber's subscription in Recurpay (status becomes cancelled; billing and deliveries stop). This is the merchant's action on a customer's subscription, not the cancellation of this MCP server's own plan. Only the merchant can re-activate it. Ask the user to confirm the subscript

tools.name: recurpay_skip_next_billing
tools.description: WRITE: skip the subscription's next billing/delivery cycle (the next order is not generated). Ask the user to confirm the subscription first.

tools.name: recurpay_renew_subscription
tools.description: WRITE, MAY CHARGE THE CUSTOMER: renew the subscription now. Recurpay runs the billing cycle immediately, which can charge the subscriber's saved payment method and create an order. Use it e.g. to retry a halted subscription. Only call it when the user explicitly asks for it and set confirm=true. Rep

tools.name: recurpay_send_payment_link
tools.description: WRITE, CONTACTS THE CUSTOMER: generate a payment link for the subscription (renewal payment or payment-method update); Recurpay notifies the subscriber with it. Use it for halted subscriptions. Only call it when the user explicitly asks for it and set confirm=true. Repeated calls may repeat the char

tools.name: recurpay_update_subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change a subscriber's contact data (email, first name, last name, phone). Only the fields you pass are sent. Ask the user to confirm the new values.

tools.name: recurpay_update_subscription_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: add or remove a discount code (coupon) on one subscription; it changes what the subscriber pays on the next billings. Ask the user to confirm.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recurpay_list_subscriptions, recurpay_list_subscribers, recurpay_list_orders · Private data: recurpay_get_access_scopes, recurpay_get_subscriber, recurpay_send_payment_link, recurpay_update_subscriber · Public sink: recurpay_list_subscriptions, recurpay_list_subscribers, recurpay_list_orders, recurpay_list_webhooks, recurpay_send_payment_link, recurpay_update_subscriber · Destructive: recurpay_update_subscription_coupon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recurpay_list_subscriptions, recurpay_list_subscribers, recurpay_list_orders · Private data: recurpay_get_access_scopes, recurpay_get_subscriber, recurpay_send_payment_link, recurpay_update_subscriber · Public sink: recurpay_list_subscriptions, recurpay_list_subscribers, recurpay_list_orders, recurpay_list_webhooks, recurpay_send_payment_link, recurpay_update_subscriber · Destructive: recurpay_update_subscription_coupon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
